context: Add table-driven behavior cases through scrub_secret_material, covering benign phrases, connector assignments, quoted assignments, and mixed messages. Define the contract in terms of returned text, not regex shape. Sequence after the vocabulary item because both touch benchbox/mcp/errors.py and tests/unit/mcp/test_errors.py; re-drive both gates before implementation to detect a concurrent fix.
description: Reduce false-positive MCP error scrubbing that currently mangles benign prose such as secret sauce, token refresh, and password reset. This is a separate precision concern from the remaining assignment vocabulary item. The scrubber must continue removing actual secret-bearing assignment/prose forms while preserving human-readable diagnostics when no value is exposed.

anti_patterns.dont: Do not assert only that output differs or contains asterisks.
anti_patterns.instead: Assert exact preservation for benign phrases and exact sentinel absence for secret cases.
anti_patterns.why: A mangled message could satisfy a weak assertion while hiding useful diagnostics.

anti_patterns.dont: Do not solve false positives by removing all secret-related scrubbing.
anti_patterns.instead: Narrow the behavior using paired secret and benign prose cases.
anti_patterns.why: That would reintroduce the concrete credential-egress defect.

preserves.behavior: Actual secret-bearing assignment/prose forms remain scrubbed.
Punctuation, exception context, and benign diagnostic wording remain readable.
The existing formatter and inline egress-reviewed marker contract.

verifications.command: uv run --all-extras -- python -c 'from benchbox.mcp.errors import scrub_secret_material; samples=["secret sauce is the default","token refresh required","password reset required"]; assert all(scrub_secret_material(x)==x for x in samples)'
verifications.description: Unfixed-tree gate: benign diagnostic phrases must remain byte-identical after scrubbing; current develop replaces secret-related prose.
verifications.expected: FAIL on unfixed develop: benign MCP prose is mangled; exits 1 before the precision fix and 0 after it.

verifications.command: uv run --all-extras -- python -c 'from benchbox.mcp.errors import scrub_secret_material; assert "REAL_SECRET" not in scrub_secret_material("password=REAL_SECRET"); assert scrub_secret_material("password field is missing")=="password field is missing"'
verifications.description: Regression guard: a real assignment remains scrubbed while a non-secret password diagnostic is preserved.
verifications.expected: PASS on current develop and after the change: secret removal remains active without broad prose damage.

work_units.summary: Re-drive benign prose and secret-bearing mixed-message cases after the vocabulary item.
Adjust scrub behavior to distinguish prose from credential values.
Add exact preservation assertions and run MCP regression checks.
